title: How to build a million dollar one-person business with AI

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: You ever wonder how one person can make a million with AI?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI tools are now so powerful, even solo founders can scale fast.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s using AI to automate a high-demand service with low overhead.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Tools like Jasper and ChatGPT let you create content, code, and designs instantly.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects freelancers, solopreneurs, and small businesses that can’t afford teams.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key is to pick a niche where AI can replace expensive labor.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Ready to build your own AI-powered million-dollar business? Let’s talk.
